title: GitHub | PRs & Code Activity
description: Captured PR transitions, latest-known PR creation cohorts, merge latency, and push activity.

options.content:
**Daily UTC trends.** All panels follow the global time picker; default: **90 days**. Auto-refresh is off to limit Athena scans. Use the dashboard links above to switch sections while preserving the time range.

**No data is not zero usage.** Only recorded dates are shown; lines may connect sparse observations. Missing source values are not replaced with zero.

Webhook silver refreshes hourly. Creation-cohort charts use the latest observed PR snapshot, even after the displayed range, so historical averages can change. Transition counts require the corresponding opened/closed webhooks. Push commit entries are not unique repository commits. This is activity, not productivity or evidence of causation.

panels.title: Pull requests & code | Captured webhook activity
PRs opened, merged & closed without merge
panels.description: Unique PRs per action/day. Openings use created_at; closures use merged_at or closed_at. Requires captured opened/closed webhooks; later review or label events do not backfill missing transitions. Repeated closures of one PR on the same day count once.

targets.rawSQL:
WITH activity AS (
  SELECT pull_request_id,
    CASE WHEN action = 'opened' THEN 'opened'
      WHEN merged = true THEN 'merged'
      WHEN merged = false THEN 'closed_unmerged' END AS activity,
    CASE WHEN action = 'opened' THEN created_at
      WHEN merged = true THEN merged_at ELSE closed_at END AS activity_at
  FROM github_webhooks_silver_dev.pull_requests
  WHERE event_type = 'pull_request' AND action IN ('opened', 'closed')
)
SELECT date_trunc('day', activity_at) AS time,
  count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN activity = 'opened' THEN pull_request_id END) AS opened,
  count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN activity = 'merged' THEN pull_request_id END) AS merged,
  count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN activity = 'closed_unmerged' THEN pull_request_id END) AS closed_unmerged
FROM activity
WHERE $__timeFilter(activity_at) AND activity IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1 ASC

panels.title: Average commits per PR | creation cohorts
panels.description: Each PR contributes its latest non-null observed commit count once, grouped by initial creation day. Snapshots can arrive after the selected time range: this is latest-known state, not an as-of historical snapshot. Missing counters are excluded.

targets.rawSQL:
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT created_at, commits,
    row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY pull_request_id
      ORDER BY updated_at DESC NULLS LAST, received_at DESC, delivery_id DESC) AS rn
  FROM github_webhooks_silver_dev.pull_requests
  WHERE event_type = 'pull_request' AND commits IS NOT NULL
    AND $__timeFilter(created_at)
)
SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS time,
  avg(commits) AS avg_commits_per_pr
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1 ASC

panels.title: PR change size | average lines added & deleted
panels.description: Latest observed non-null additions/deletions snapshot per PR, grouped by initial creation day. Historical cohorts change as PRs evolve. Source counters are not added across webhook deliveries.

targets.rawSQL:
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT created_at, additions, deletions,
    row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY pull_request_id
      ORDER BY updated_at DESC NULLS LAST, received_at DESC, delivery_id DESC) AS rn
  FROM github_webhooks_silver_dev.pull_requests
  WHERE event_type = 'pull_request' AND additions IS NOT NULL AND deletions IS NOT NULL
    AND $__timeFilter(created_at)
)
SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS time,
  avg(additions) AS avg_lines_added,
  avg(deletions) AS avg_lines_deleted
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1 ASC

panels.title: Time to merge | median & p95
panels.description: Elapsed wall-clock hours from initial creation to merge, grouped by merge day. Includes draft/wait time; not active engineering time. Deduplicated by PR ID. Unmerged PRs are excluded, so this is not backlog age.

targets.rawSQL:
WITH merged_prs AS (
  SELECT pull_request_id, min(created_at) AS created_at, max(merged_at) AS merged_at
  FROM github_webhooks_silver_dev.pull_requests
  WHERE event_type = 'pull_request' AND action = 'closed' AND merged = true
    AND $__timeFilter(merged_at)
  GROUP BY pull_request_id
)
SELECT date_trunc('day', merged_at) AS time,
  approx_percentile(date_diff('second', created_at, merged_at) / 3600.0, 0.5) AS median_hours,
  approx_percentile(date_diff('second', created_at, merged_at) / 3600.0, 0.95) AS p95_hours
FROM merged_prs
WHERE created_at IS NOT NULL AND merged_at >= created_at
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1 ASC

panels.title: Push activity | deliveries & forced pushes
panels.description: Push webhook deliveries and deliveries explicitly flagged as forced. Silver deduplicates delivery_id; repeated pushes remain separate activity. Commit counts are not inferred from delivery counts.

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT date_trunc('day', event_at) AS time,
  count(*) AS push_deliveries,
  count_if(forced = true) AS forced_push_deliveries
FROM github_webhooks_silver_dev.push_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_at)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1 ASC
